name: Work Permit and Permit of Stay (Foreign Employee)

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must submit a written application including comprehensive details about the foreign employee, along with a Ministry-approved employment contract.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an employer willing to file the application and obtain Ministry approval of the employment contract.

requirements.blocker_text: Must provide academic qualifications or skills documentation and a professional CV.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in sources located in this build

sources.title: Federal Republic of Somalia, official government services portal -- Permit of Stay for foreign employees: requires employer's written application with comprehensive employee details, valid passport (12+ months), Ministry-approved employment contract, valid work permit, academic qualifications/skills documentation, professional CV; processed in-person at regional centers via the Immigration and Citizenship Agency; fee US$5 payable by mobile money to the regional center's bank account

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Somalia). Published on tier-1 sourcing (the Federal Government of Somalia's own services portal). NOTABLY LOW FEE compared to every other country built in this dataset: US$5, paid via mobile money -- consistent with Somalia's widespread mobile-money-based financial infrastructure operating in the absence of a fully developed conventional banking sector. Duration/validity period was not specified in the source; disclosed as a gap rather than guessed. work_rights set to 'restricted' since the permit is tied to a specific Ministry-approved employment contract rather than an open labour-market right. POLITICAL CONTEXT: see so_visitor_visa.json notes -- this dataset models the Federal Government's stated framework; administrability varies by region given Al-Shabaab's territorial control and Somaliland's de facto separate governance.
